name: get_unchecked_mut
declaration: unsafe fn get_unchecked_mut < I : SliceIndex < str > > (& mut self , i : I) -> & mut I :: Output
rules: For safety, the starting index specified by `i` must not exceed its ending index.
For safety, the indexes specified by `i` must be within bounds of the original `str`.
For safety, the indexes specified by `i` must lie on UTF-8 sequence boundaries.
